notes.title: Update patch - November 30th 2015
notes.content:
Hey there people we have patched up BRAWL.

Here is the log:

- AI difficulty changes. Low AI difficulty is now even lower, making the battles easier. We have also patched up a bug where low difficulty bots would behave as on ultra difficulty.

- UI changes - a lot of small changes and fixes to the User Interface.

- Team Arena - we have improved the Online Team Arena Game Mode it now should work like a charm having all of the necessary options including friend invites and rules.

- fixed an issue where you couldn't send an invite to your friends to play a game of BRAWL

Have a blast with the new update!

notes.title: Big Head Update
notes.content:
Big head update - 09-11-2015

Bombs Away! We're here with a long awaited update that brings a lot of stuff you demanded plus a lot more. Read on! 

•	Tweaks to single player campaigns – the boss battles are easier and shorter than before.

•	A new challenge mode called “Who’s the boss” where you will face alone, or with a friend, boss after boss. You will have limited time and the mobs spawning will grow in numbers. You can extend the time limit by picking up time power-ups.

•	Team Arena goes Online.

•	Coveted Multiplayer – now you can team up with a friend (or friends) on one PC locally and play against multiplayer opponents.

•	Exploding bodies – the game became even more gruesome! 

•	Big heads option – turned on or off from the menu .

•	Steam Leaderboards support

•	Russian language support
